canonical_statement: The review was prospectively registered in PROSPERO as CRD42021247584 and followed PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-NMA reporting guidance.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This study was prospectively registered with PROSPERO (CRD42021247584) and conducted in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 guidelines and the PRISMA-NMA extension.

canonical_statement: CENTRAL, Web of Science, PubMed, and Embase were searched from inception through March 30, 2025.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We systematically searched CENTRAL, Web of Science, PubMed, and Embase ... covering records from database inception to March 30, 2025.

canonical_statement: Three reviewers independently performed the initial search and screening, with discrepancies resolved by a fourth reviewer.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Three independent reviewers (Tong, Li, and Yue) performed the initial literature search and screening ... discrepancies were resolved ... with a fourth reviewer (Hu).

canonical_statement: The authors manually searched EASD and ADA proceedings plus ClinicalTrials.gov and PROSPERO to identify unpublished or ongoing trials.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: we manually searched the proceedings of the European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD) and American Diabetes Association (ADA), as well as the ClinicalTrials.gov and PROSPERO databases

canonical_statement: Two reviewers extracted study data using standardized forms, a third reviewer cross-checked the extraction, and discrepancies were resolved by consensus.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: two independent reviewers (Tong and Li) extracted data using standardized forms ... cross-checked by a third reviewer (Hu), with discrepancies resolved through consensus.

canonical_statement: Risk of bias was assessed with Cochrane RoB 2 by two reviewers.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The methodological quality of included RCTs was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias Tool for Randomized Trials (RoB 2)

canonical_statement: Publication bias was assessed using funnel plots and Egger’s test.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: funnel plots were generated, and asymmetry was statistically evaluated using the Egger’s test.

canonical_statement: CINeMA was used to assess evidence certainty across within-study bias, reporting bias, indirectness, imprecision, heterogeneity, and inconsistency.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the Confidence in Network Meta-Analysis (CINeMA) framework was applied to evaluate evidence certainty across six domains

canonical_statement: A Bayesian network meta-analysis was performed in R with gemtc version 3.4.1.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We performed a Bayesian network meta-analysis using the “gemtc” package in R (v3.4.1).

canonical_statement: Random-effects heterogeneity used a half-normal prior with scale 0.5, and treatment effects used vague normal priors.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the heterogeneity parameter (τ2) ... was assigned a half-normal prior with a scale parameter of 0.5 ... Priors for treatment effects ... were set as normal distributions with a mean of 0 and a large variance

canonical_statement: Fixed- and random-effects models were compared using DIC, with the lower-DIC model selected.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Fixed- and random-effects models were compared via the deviance information criterion (DIC), with the model yielding the lowest DIC selected

canonical_statement: MCMC used four chains, 20,000 burn-in iterations, and 60,000 sampling iterations.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm was implemented with 4 chains, 20,000 burn-in iterations, and 60,000 sampling iterations

canonical_statement: Convergence was assessed with PSRF targeting 1.00–1.05 plus trace and density plots.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Model convergence was assessed using the Potential Scale Reduction Factor (PSRF; target range: 1.00–1.05), supported by trace and density plots

canonical_statement: Closed loops were evaluated with node-splitting, transitivity was assessed using baseline characteristics, and heterogeneity was summarized with I² derived from posterior τ².

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: closed loops prompting inconsistency testing via the node-splitting method ... Transitivity assumptions were verified ... Heterogeneity was quantified using the I2 statistic

canonical_statement: Treatment rankings were summarized with SUCRA, and effects were reported as mean differences with 95% credible intervals.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: treatment rankings were estimated via the Surface Under the Cumulative Ranking Curve (SUCRA). Results were expressed as mean differences (MD) with 95% credible intervals (CrI).

canonical_statement: Sensitivity analyses used frequentist random-effects network meta-analysis, BMI-stratified analyses, and exclusion of trials with sample size below 50.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: sensitivity analyses included: (1) frequentist random-effects meta-analysis ... (2) subgroup analyses stratified by baseline BMI; and (3) exclusion of trials with sample sizes < 50.
